items.Sentence: The septic tank for the new Visitor Contact Center will have a 55,000 gallon capacity.
New 6-inch PVC pipe will convey effluent from all three new septic tanks to a 20,000 gallon dosing tank for flow equalization.
The effluent will be discharged from the dosing tank into a new 3-acre leachfield ... consist of a pressure distribution leach trench constructed in four cells.
